newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Citibank appoints Grant Bailey chief investment officer.
newsitem.headline: Citibank appoints Grant Bailey chief investment officer.

text.p: Citicorp said it had appointed Grant Bailey chief investment officer and investment business head of Australia and New Zealand.
Bailey, who has been with Citibank since 1991 as chief economist, would have responsibility for the investment and business side of Citicorp Global Asset Management, Citicorp said.
"Citicorp is fully committed to building its retail and wholesale investment management business both globally and in Australasia," Citibank managing director Bill Ferguson said in a statement.
"As a senior member of our country management team, Grant Bailey's appointment is an important step in demonstrating this commitment."
Senior economist Stephen Koukoulas is to take on the role of chief economist.
